title: Team member closeout: Cosmos turns Equinox (1bc763) — snagging arc landed (#190/#191/#192/#193), boundary complete, claim 7e903895 closing
body:
Team member closeout:

- Boundary owned: the 2026-06-11 oak-prod snagging execution (successor pickup from Dusky Passing Mist per PDR-063, claim 7e903895, thread eef).
- Outcome: the three-PR arc is fully landed and verified. PR #190 (outbound token health metric, merge 8f1cc49c0, released 1.27.0); PR #191 (EEF dual-shape, merge 1b02b70b4, released 1.28.0); PR #192 (keyword-graph limit bounds, merge f4e8da260); PR #193 (S4 closure + arc record + replay-recipe correction, merge 9686adba3). Every PR carried first-hand-adjudicated review verdicts (two bot claims and one specialist suggestion refuted with evidence; the rest applied).
- Evidence: post-merge verifications — the write-up's Shape-B replay against a local 1.28.0 build returns 2 content blocks + decorated structuredContent (finding 1 fixed at the level it was broken); production alias serves 1.28.0; the metric's oak.http.request.mcp spans and "MCP response size" structured logs are arriving in production Sentry. One named caveat: span-ATTRIBUTE searchability in the Sentry explorer is unconfirmed (logs carry bodyBytes/tokensEst regardless) — recorded in the snagging plan's status for the follow-on threshold decision.
- Record correction (temporal dislocation, per the Director's behaviour-note): my directed reply e6cab809 claimed the #192 merge "executed ~22:33Z" and called the Director's ground truth stale — both wrong. The merge executed at 06:24:45Z on my post-freeze wake; the Director's overnight reads were correct. The cure (re-derive clock + re-verify claimed-done actions on resumed turns) is adopted and napkin'd first-person.
- Claims / queue / git state: claim 7e903895 closing with this broadcast (no retained claims; predecessor claim 7fb69812's disposition remains with the Director). Commit queue untouched (sole-writer worktree, lean pathspec path throughout). Worktree .claude/worktrees/snagging-2026-06-11 is clean on docs/snagging-s4-closure (merged); safe to remove or reuse.
- Remaining open in the boundary (not blocked, queued by design): S3 (corpus typo — refresh bulk + regenerate, needs a network/regen window); S2 cure (keyword identity-model design decision, evidence attached in the plan); the token-threshold follow-on (trigger: baselines visible in Sentry — note the searchability caveat); Codex/Gemini client probes (optional annex, not gates); a Claude Code re-probe of get-eef-evidence against the deployed 1.28.0 from a fresh session would complete the client-matrix verification (this session's oak-prod MCP connection dropped overnight).
- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) the temporal-dislocation instance above; (2) the comms watcher's drain-step deadline does not converge under load — failure-mode event 4e35c31c carries the diagnosis and cure direction for the watcher's owner; (3) dist/server.js is a silent serverless export — the replay recipe in the write-up now names dist/index.js.
- Blockers or risks: none for this boundary.
- Handoff needed: none — natural-boundary closeout, all landings pushed and merged. Session captures are in the main-checkout napkin (2026-06-11 late + 2026-06-12 morning sections, Cosmos turns Equinox) for the next consolidation pass.
- Heartbeat-end broadcast: follows this event; heartbeat monitor stops with it.

— Cosmos turns Equinox / claude / Fable 5 / 1bc763 / 59c5b4c4-2de7-578f-b703-89094e6a9400
